The '''Arena of Byss''' was a structure on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] that was used by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] when they ruled that world. It was used as a site for gladiatorial combat where the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] sent their slaves such as their [[Force Hound]]s into combat with one another. Within the Arena, combatants fought to the death where they fought for their survival and no mercy was expected amongst challengers.

Within these chambers, [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] who was a rising Force Hound battled the reigning champion [[Isk (Force Hound)|Isk]] in combat. His victory led to [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]]'s rise in power as Xesh was his servant.
